value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER right away, or call 911 if you can't get there quickly. Fever with a stiff neck and severe headache can be serious and can't be sorted out at home. Don't wait until morning.
value.triage: Call 911 now if your child is hard to wake, confused, seizing, has a rash that doesn't fade when pressed with a glass, or is breathing badly. Otherwise go to the ER now. 811 is not the first step here.
